description: Each AI model's posted API prices in USD per 1M input, cached input and output tokens and its price at the mix of tokens agents send (the models behind the token index and the Intelligence Index chart's, each with its page), with its usage share and its 1-month change. Give a model (name or page id, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5" or "kimi-k3") for its daily price history as its page's chart draws it, or a company to list its models. Every other model OpenRouter prices is on the Every AI model page (https://computescreener.com/models): give its name or id (e.g. "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct"), or every: true to list them all.

every.description: List every model on the Every AI model page (/models), not only those with a page.

model.description: A model's name, page id or OpenRouter id; omit to list models.

name: get_model_prices

cache_read_price.description: Posted USD per 1M cached input tokens (the input price where none is posted)

change_1m_pct.description: Change of its price at the mix over 1 month, percent (its page's 1M)

list_price.description: 3 input : 1 output, USD per 1M tokens (break-even throughput uses it)

lowest_price.description: The lowest provider's price at the mix, USD per 1M tokens

price.description: USD per 1M tokens at the mix (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output)

priced_by.description: company: its maker's own price; providers: the median of the providers serving it

providers.description: Providers serving it at a standard price

source_url.description: Where its prices can be checked

usage_share.description: Share of the company's tokens that day (0 to 1); null outside the index

title: AI model API prices
